# Sentinel

> Sentinel is a free, privacy-first civic-protection platform for anonymously reporting a missing child or another protection incident, and for subscribing to verified safety alerts for a chosen area. No account or personal information is required to report; the app works offline and sends automatically once back online.

Sentinel exists to close the gap between a bystander who witnesses an incident and the organizations (police, NGOs, schools) who can actually help. A report is never acted on automatically: a trust-granted human reviewer verifies it and issues any alert, and AI is used only to suggest structured fields from the report text — never to make a decision.

## Key facts

- Reporting requires no account, no login, and no personal information; the reporter's identity is never recorded.
- The app works fully offline and queues a report for automatic sending once connectivity returns.
- Available in English and French, detected automatically from the browser's language.
- Citizens can subscribe to push notifications for specific incident types, minimum severity, and geographic areas.
- The underlying platform (case verification, alert policy, delivery) is open source under the MIT license.

## Primary pages

- [Report an incident](https://sentinel.africalineage.com/): the main app — report a missing child or protection incident, or manage alert subscriptions.

## For organizations

Police, NGOs, schools, and other trust-granted organizations use a separate, authenticated reviewer portal (not intended for public search discovery) to verify reports, manage cases, and issue alerts.

## Source and contact

- Source code: https://github.com/syntrydy/SafeCameroon (MIT license)
- This is a civic-technology project; there is no commercial entity or paid tier.
